filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Thu Nov 19 (after the morning run) – Fri Nov 20 morning PT (items already on the Nov 18–19 briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: Sales vendors kept filling in OpenAI's ChatGPT for Sales roster on Nov 19, two days after launch, each pitching data a CRM lacks. On Nov 20 Reply.io went the other way, shipping an open-source outbound harness that runs inside the coding agent a seller already pays for.

bullets.text: Nov 19: Nooks' ChatGPT plugin lets customers prospect, build sequences, check deal status and draft follow-ups, using call-derived context that overrides stale CRM fields; it is Nooks' first surface outside its own app and may need admin enablement.
Nov 19: Actively put its per-account agents (CRM, call and email context plus external signals) into ChatGPT Work and Codex for territory ranking, meeting prep and next-contact picks.
Nov 20: Reply.io's MIT-licensed Jason Harness turns Claude Code or Codex into a nine-role outbound team on the user's own model subscription; Reply sends, and every message needs a human yes.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic closes debut at $97.17, then slips Friday
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 19: ANT opened at $111.50 and closed 17% above the $83 offer (~$1.8T fully diluted, 846M+ shares traded). Nov 20: trading near $87.68 (−9.8%) late morning ET.

biggest_ai_news.title: Claude Data is on by default for Enterprise today
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 20: dashboards and data stories built on connected warehouses and apps (e.g. Salesforce) switch on for Enterprise orgs unless an Owner already saved a setting; certified queries and live sharing stay off.

biggest_ai_news.title: ChatGPT adds Live Dictation
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 19: voice prompts now transcribe as you speak on all plans, and the 10-minute recording limit is gone.

what_changed.title: Nooks joins ChatGPT for Sales
what_changed.body: Nov 19: Nooks customers can prospect, add contacts to sequences, draft emails, ask where a deal stands and what was promised on the last call, review at-risk pipeline and coach reps from ChatGPT. Nooks says its agents reconcile CRM data against live call context; first integration outside its own platform, with 'more coming soon'.

what_changed.title: Actively ships a ChatGPT plugin
what_changed.body: Nov 19: Actively's account-intelligence agents run in ChatGPT Work and Codex for finding high-fit accounts, ranking a territory, meeting prep and choosing the next stakeholder; some connections need admin approval.

what_changed.title: Reply.io open-sources an AI SDR harness for coding agents
what_changed.body: Nov 20: Jason Harness (alpha, MIT) installs into Claude Code or Codex with nine roles (Planner, Researcher, Copywriter, Critic, Deliverability and more), plans per-contact sequences, and uses the user's own model subscription; Reply's paid platform does the sending.

what_changed.title: Clay adds an upgrade incentive for its global agent
what_changed.body: Nov 19: co-founder Varun Anand said every user who upgrades their Clay plan before the weekend gets a copy of GTA6, tied to the global agent launch (covered Nov 19).

quiet_note: No launch, funding, M&A or pricing of their own from Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco dated Nov 19–20. Salesforce's Nov 19 Cyber Week forecast and SI export consortium are not GTM news; Agentforce Coworker's 185K-user story is dated Nov 4.

market_direction.text: Nooks and Actively shipped ChatGPT plugins Nov 19, after Attio and Outreach on Nov 18.

market_direction.label: New (GTM tools packaged as harnesses for coding agents)
market_direction.text: Reply.io's open-source harness runs outbound inside Claude Code or Codex, billed through the vendor's sending platform rather than seats (Nov 20).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (analytics agents turned on by default)
market_direction.text: Claude Data defaults on for Enterprise orgs Nov 20, with Salesforce among the connectable sources.

market_direction.text: No new announcements of their own Nov 19–20.

Nooks' pitch that call and sequence data, not CRM fields, should decide where a deal stands (Nov 19).
Actively's framing of one agent working each account, now callable from ChatGPT (Nov 19).

competitive_moves.text: ChatGPT for Sales plugin: prospecting, sequencing, deal follow-up, pipeline and coaching from ChatGPT (Nov 19).
GTA6 giveaway for plan upgrades before the weekend, tied to the global agent launch (Nov 19).

watch.title: Wed Dec 2: Salesforce Q3 FY27 results
watch.body: Salesforce's Nov 10 IR release sets results for Dec 2 after the close (2:00 PM PT call); a Nov 20 Salesforce LinkedIn post says Dec 3 at 2 PM PT, so confirm the date. First quarter with the $50/user Agentforce Coworker SKU (Nov 4), the Cresta deal (Nov 2) and Copilotforce (Nov 17).

interpretation.fact: Nov 19 Nooks and Actively launched ChatGPT plugins; Nov 20 Reply.io released an open-source outbound harness for Claude Code and Codex. Nov 19 Anthropic closed its first trading day at $97.17 (open $111.50, IPO $83) and fell to about $87.68 on Nov 20; Claude Data turned on by default for Enterprise on Nov 20; ChatGPT added Live Dictation Nov 19. Clay's Varun Anand offered GTA6 for plan upgrades before the weekend. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Salesloft and Monaco announced nothing new of their own Nov 19–20.
interpretation.interpretation: Engagement and intelligence vendors are racing to be the context layer behind ChatGPT, differentiating on data a CRM never captures (calls, signals). Reply.io's harness suggests a second route where the vendor keeps only the sending and deliverability layer and lets the buyer's own coding agent do the planning.

feed.summary: Varun Anand said Clay will give GTA6 to every user who upgrades their Clay plan before the weekend, to mark the global agent launch.
